userStories.title: Add plan-verdict-report module (auditor structured exit file)
userStories.description: As the deterministic plan-runner, I need a structured file channel for the auditor's verdict so I can parse APPROVE/BLOCK from a JSON file (deterministic) instead of pane scrollback (rendered markdown is unparseable, per the supervisor-sentinel-parse-fragility invariant).
acceptanceCriteria: A new module src/supervisor/plan-verdict-report.ts exports a PlanVerdictReport interface mirroring the auditor's REAL output schema: top-level { verdict: 'APPROVE' | 'BLOCK', summary: string, findings: PlanVerdictFinding[] } where each PlanVerdictFinding is { id: string; category: string; severity: string; storyId?: string; description: string; suggestion?: string } (finding text field is `description`, NOT `text`), and a PLAN_VERDICT_REPORT_FILENAME constant equal to 'scripts/cam/plan-verdict-report.json'. [oracle: grep -q "PLAN_VERDICT_REPORT_FILENAME = 'scripts/cam/plan-verdict-report.json'" src/supervisor/plan-verdict-report.ts]

A makeReadPlanVerdict(cwd) factory returns a reader () => PlanVerdictReport | null that reads the file, returns null on any read/parse error, and validates the discriminator: it rejects (returns null for) parsed values that are arrays or whose `verdict` field is not the string 'APPROVE' or 'BLOCK' (JSON reader shape-guard invariant, patterns.md 'JSON reader shape guards'). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-verdict-report.test.ts]
The report file path is added to both .gitignore and templates/.gitignore (ephemeral, never committed), symmetric to review-report.json. [oracle: grep -q 'plan-verdict-report.json' .gitignore]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Full quality spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Mirror src/supervisor/review-report.ts (CAM-75) EXACTLY: ReviewReport/REVIEW_REPORT_FILENAME + makeReadReviewReport-in-host.ts is the precedent shape. IMPORTANT (F-01): mirror the auditor's REAL output field names from .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md 'Output format' block: top-level { verdict, summary, findings, metrics }, and each finding is { id, category, severity, storyId, description, suggestion } - the finding text field is `description`, NOT `text`. Carry id/category/storyId?/suggestion? and the top-level `summary` so findings round-trip into Half B (CAM-151 re-plan loop feeds findings back to the planner) with no schema change. `metrics` is optional to model (Half A does not branch on it). Apply the 'JSON reader shape guards: validate discriminator fields, not just typeof' pattern (patterns.md US-R2-001): guard `!Array.isArray(parsed) && (parsed.verdict === 'APPROVE' || parsed.verdict === 'BLOCK')` before the cast - the load-bearing `verdict` discriminator is the ONLY value Half A branches on; keep it exactly as-is. Since .gitignore edits do not touch vendor/ or embedded code, no embed-vendor run is needed for the .gitignore change; but templates/.gitignore IS under templates/ so run `bun run embed-vendor` and confirm embed-vendor:check (folded into check:all). This is the structured-handback channel from patterns.md 'capture-pane is rendered markdown'.

userStories.title: Add deterministic plan pre-flight in TS
userStories.description: As the plan-runner, I need a deterministic pre-flight that runs git checkout main, git pull, prune merged cam/* branches, a clean-working-tree check, typecheck, and tests, halting with a clear error BEFORE any planner spawn, so the plan phase never starts from a dirty or broken base.
acceptanceCriteria: A new module (src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts) exports runPlanPreflight({ cwd, spawnFn, ... }) returning a discriminated union { ok: true } | { ok: false; step: string; detail: string }, where every git/bun call goes through the injected spawnFn (no real process spawned in unit tests). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts]

Pre-flight runs, in order: `git checkout main`, `git pull` (origin main), prune of merged `cam/*` local branches (best-effort, skipped silently when `gh` is unavailable), a clean-working-tree check via `git status --porcelain` (non-empty output => halt with step 'clean-tree'), `bun run typecheck`, `bun test`; the FIRST failing required step returns { ok: false } with that step name and no later step runs. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts]

A failing typecheck or test halts pre-flight (returns ok:false) so no planner is ever spawned on a broken base; the branch-prune step is best-effort and never halts. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Full quality spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Port the LLM-driven Step 0 of cam-plan.md (git checkout main / git pull origin main / prune merged cam/* / git status / typecheck / tests) into deterministic TS. Precedents: src/supervisor/preflight-container.ts (discriminated-union PreflightResult shape + injectable probe seam) and host.ts runGates (spawnSync 'bun' ['run','typecheck'] then ['test']). Use the spawnSync exit-status guard (patterns.md US-R1-001): spawnSync does NOT throw on non-zero; check `(result.status ?? 1) !== 0`. Prune loop mirrors cam-plan.md Step 0.2: `git for-each-ref refs/heads/cam/` + `gh pr list --head <b> --state merged`; skip silently if `gh` absent (Bun.which('gh') === null or spawn ENOENT). Keep the pure gating logic separate from the git argv so tests assert argv shape with no network. This is HAPPY-PATH only: in-progress-work conflict detection is OUT OF SCOPE (CAM-151 Half B).

userStories.title: Add the deterministic plan-runner driver (pick-issue, spawn planner, spawn auditor, read verdict)
userStories.description: As cam, I need a deterministic plan-runner that runs pre-flight, picks the plannable issue, spawns the planner pane, then the auditor pane, and reads the auditor verdict from the file, so the plan phase is TS-driven with the LLM only at the planner/auditor judgment points.
acceptanceCriteria: A new module (src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts) exports runPlanPhase(opts) with all side effects injected (spawnFn, isPaneAlive, sleepFn, genUuid, selectIssueFn, readPlanVerdictFn, preflightFn, clock), returning a discriminated result covering at least { kind: 'preflight-failed' }, { kind: 'no-plannable-issue' }, { kind: 'audit-approved' }, and { kind: 'audit-blocked' }. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner.test.ts]
When preflight returns ok:false, runPlanPhase returns { kind: 'preflight-failed' } and spawns NO planner or auditor pane. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner.test.ts]

Pick-issue delegates to selectPlannableFromFile (CAM-106, src/issues/select.ts); when it returns null, runPlanPhase returns { kind: 'no-plannable-issue' } as a clean terminal (not a thrown error) and spawns no pane. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner.test.ts]

On the happy path the runner spawns the planner pane (respawn-pane -k with buildPlannerWorkerArgv), polls until the pane dies or prd.json is written, then spawns the auditor pane (buildAuditorWorkerArgv) and polls until the plan-verdict-report.json is present (read via readPlanVerdictFn, never from capture-pane); the test asserts the exact spawn sequence and that the session-id passed is lowercase. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner.test.ts]

Before each planner/auditor respawn the runner sets the pane @cam_label (via `tmux set-option -p -t <pane> @cam_label`) to 'planner'/'auditor' and asserts the mutex (dispatch only when the session has exactly 2 panes, via paneCountMutex); a busy session yields a clean non-spawn result. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Full quality spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Mirror the dep-injected driver shape of makeReviewDispatch in src/supervisor/review.ts (spawn/capturePane/isPaneAlive/sleepFn/now injected; poll loop that breaks on report-file present OR pane-death OR timeout). Reuse: selectPlannableFromFile (src/issues/select.ts), buildPlannerWorkerArgv/buildAuditorWorkerArgv (US-003), makeReadPlanVerdict (US-001), runPlanPreflight (US-004). Spawn invariants (patterns.md): env -u via workerEnvPrefix (in US-003 argv), lowercase --session-id (CAM-23 'macos-uuidgen-uppercase': lowercase the genUuid() output), @cam_label set BEFORE respawn (patterns.md '@cam_label pane-labeling'), paneCountMutex from src/tmux/session.ts (1 worker-pane at a time now also covers planner/auditor). This story does NOT wire the post-audit commit/branch/flip (that is US-006) and does NOT implement a BLOCK->re-plan loop (CAM-151 Half B). NOTE for auditor: this is a pane worker here (deterministic-loop-driven), which is the correct home per patterns.md 'Pane worker vs Task subagent' now that the sidecar (not the LLM /cam-plan flow) drives the plan phase.

userStories.title: Wire auto-mode post-audit action: commit PRD, create branch, flip active:true; escalate on BLOCK
userStories.description: As cam in auto mode, when the auditor APPROVEs I need the runner to commit the audited PRD, create the feature branch, and flip active:true so the existing loop.ts assumes implement->review->ship; on BLOCK I need it to escalate to the operator (pause + notify) with no automated re-plan.
acceptanceCriteria: On { kind: 'audit-approved' } AND decidePostAuditAction(readPlanApproval()) === { kind: 'proceed-branch' } (auto mode), the runner: creates the branch from main (git checkout -b <branchName>), commits scripts/cam/prd.json, and flips active:true (via an injected flipActiveFn that writes .claude/cam-loop.local.md), each step through the injected spawnFn/flipActiveFn; the test asserts the branch-create precedes the prd commit and that flipActiveFn is called exactly once. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-postaudit.test.ts]

When decidePostAuditAction returns { kind: 'pause-operator' } (operator mode), the runner does NOT branch/commit/flip and returns a distinct result (e.g. { kind: 'awaiting-operator-approval' }); the operator-gate reviewing the full PRD is OUT OF SCOPE for Half A (CAM-151). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-postaudit.test.ts]

On { kind: 'audit-blocked' } the runner escalates to the operator via an injected escalateFn/notifyFn (pause + notify) and does NOT branch/commit/flip and does NOT re-spawn the planner (no automated re-plan loop in Half A); escalateFn is best-effort (never throws) like sendEscalation. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-postaudit.test.ts]

The runner consumes decidePostAuditAction and readPlanApproval from src/plan/plan-approval-decision.ts and src/config/models.ts unchanged (does not reimplement the decision). [oracle: grep -q 'decidePostAuditAction' src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts]

userStories.notes: Follow docs/adr/0003-worker-isolation-boundary-dev-container.md format precedent EXACTLY (the new ADR is 0004). Apply the ADR three-gate test from scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md 'Domain Model Convention': hard-to-reverse (the plan phase moves from LLM-orchestrated /cam-plan Task subagents to a deterministic sidecar runner spawning panes) + surprising-without-context (the planner/auditor are now panes not Task subagents, reversing the patterns.md 'Pane worker vs Task subagent' dividing line for the plan phase) + genuine-trade-off (deterministic runner loses LLM flexibility in orchestrating the plan flow, gains the deterministic guards). No em-dash / no decorative emoji in persisted .md (global CLAUDE.md rule + patterns.md 'No em-dash in persisted .md'). docs/adr/ is not under vendor/ or templates/, so no embed-vendor run needed.
